3.name: Combat Superiority & Student of War (Battle Master)
3.description: Gain 3 maneuvers and 4 Superiority Dice (d8), plus proficiency in one Artisan's Tool and one skill available to Fighters.

7.name: Know Your Enemy (Battle Master)
7.description: As a Bonus Action, learn whether a creature within 30 feet has Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities and what they are (recharges on Long Rest or by spending a Superiority Die).

10.name: Improved Combat Superiority (Battle Master)
10.description: Your Superiority Dice increase to d10s.

15.name: Relentless (Battle Master)
15.description: Once per turn when you use a maneuver, you can roll 1d8 and use that roll instead of expending a Superiority Die.

18.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority (Battle Master)
18.description: Your Superiority Dice increase to d12s.

superiority_dice.name: Superiority Die
superiority_dice.hint: Spend one on a maneuver. Pool of 4, rising to 5 at 7th and 6 at 15th.

3.name: Improved Critical & Remarkable Athlete (Champion)
3.description: Critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. In addition, thanks to athletic prowess, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks; running jump distance increases by STR modifier in feet.

7.name: Additional Fighting Style (Champion)
7.description: Choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

10.name: Heroic Warrior (Champion)
10.description: Whenever you start your turn in combat with 0 Temporary Hit Points, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration.

15.name: Superior Critical (Champion)
15.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

18.name: Survivor (Champion)
18.description: At the start of each of your turns, you regain 5 + CON modifier HP if you have no more than half your HP left, and have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

improved_critical.name: Improved Critical
improved_critical.hint: Widened crit range — the Attack button already flags these as crits.

3.name: Spellcasting & War Bond (Eldritch Knight)
3.description: Augment martial prowess with Wizard spells (INT) and bond with up to two weapons so you cannot be disarmed and can summon them as a Bonus Action.

7.name: War Magic (Eldritch Knight)
7.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with a casting of one of your Wizard cantrips with a casting time of an action.

10.name: Eldritch Strike (Eldritch Knight)
10.description: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

15.name: Arcane Charge (Eldritch Knight)
15.description: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see before or after the additional action.

18.name: Improved War Magic (Eldritch Knight)
18.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace two of your attacks with a casting of one of your Level 1 or Level 2 Wizard spells that has a casting time of an action.

3.name: Psionic Power (Psi Warrior)
3.description: Gain a pool of Psionic Energy Dice (d6) to fuel Protective Field, Psionic Strike, and Telekinetic Movement.

7.name: Telekinetic Adept (Psi Warrior)
7.description: Gain Psi-Powered Leap (Fly Speed equal to double Speed until turn end) and Telekinetic Thrust (push or knock target Prone when dealing Psionic Strike damage).

10.name: Guarded Mind (Psi Warrior)
10.description: Gain Resistance to Psychic damage, and expend a Psionic Energy Die at the start of your turn to end Charmed and Frightened conditions on yourself.

15.name: Bulwark of Force (Psi Warrior)
15.description: As a Bonus Action, grant Half Cover to yourself and allies within 30 feet (up to INT modifier creatures) for 1 minute.

18.name: Telekinetic Master (Psi Warrior)
18.description: Always have Telekinesis prepared, cast it once per Long Rest (or by spending a Psionic Energy Die), and make a weapon attack as a Bonus Action while concentrating on it.

psionic_strike.name: Psionic Strike
psionic_strike.hint: Once per turn on a weapon hit within 30 ft: expend a Psionic Energy Die to add Die + INT mod Force damage.

protective_field.name: Protective Field
protective_field.hint: Reaction reduces damage to yourself or an ally within 30 ft by Psionic Energy Die + INT mod.
